newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIAN OPPOSITION HOLDS NEW RALLY.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIAN OPPOSITION HOLDS NEW RALLY.

text.p: Bulgarian opposition supporters held a fresh rally on Saturday outside Sofia's gold-domed cathedral, after riot police put an end to their 10-hour siege of parliament.

State news agency BTA said 97 people were injured in clashes between protesters and police who fired blank cartridges and used clubs to beat a path from the parliament building early on Saturday to evacuate deputies from the governing Socialist party.
